read_gap.handling: Do not infer stale derived state. Fresh MISSION_STATE is used for formal authority; review scope remains executable v1/v2/v2.1 plus contracts/tests.

agreements: v2.1 correctly separates verified_experience_delta from operational_progress_delta at its output boundary.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only in v2.1 and do not become verified Experience.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/wait/scheduler wake remain zero-credit runtime maintenance in inherited v2 semantics.
Anti-thrash does not intercept safety/recovery downshifts because it only applies when selected_n > current_n.
v2.1 explicitly has formal_mutation_allowed=false and cannot itself mutate P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance.

The v2.1 contract correctly states that speed improvement is not established and names durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency as required metrics.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied booleans. The controller does not bind freshness to a timestamp/TTL/source fingerprint nor authority conflict to an exact fresh authority snapshot. A caller can pass secretary_signal_fresh=true and authority_conflict=false for stale or conflicting secretary data.
disagreements.required_change: Replace free booleans for live/adoptable mode with a validated SecretarySignalEnvelope containing signal_hash, source identity, issued_at, observed_at, TTL/freshness policy hash, authority_snapshot_hash and verifier/provider identity. Derive conflict/freshness inside the trusted host boundary.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience credit depends only on event_kind plus bool(event_independently_verified/independently_verified). No exact evidence hash, C/independent verifier identity, verification receipt, revocation/freshness state or installation/workspace binding is checked. Python bool coercion also means a non-empty string such as 'false' would evaluate True in aggregate_experience_events.
disagreements.required_change: Verified event credit must consume a structured verifier receipt bound to exact event payload hash/evidence hash, verifier identity/role, verification policy, mission/step, installation/workspace identity and acceptance/revocation state. Strict bool coercion is insufficient.

disagreements.finding: Experience ledger dedupe uses only event_id. The same underlying event can be replayed under a new event_id and receive credit again.
disagreements.required_change: Deduplicate on canonical event/evidence lineage identity, not caller label alone: canonical_event_hash + source lineage + evidence hash + verification receipt identity. event_id may remain an index but not the sole uniqueness key.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio>=0.50 suppresses any nonessential upshift, but the controller receives no sample count, observation window, exposure denominator, confidence bound or minimum-support rule. One shift in one observation can be indistinguishable from a stable high-rate regime.
disagreements.required_change: Bind recent_shift_rate_ratio to a versioned observation window and sufficient-support metadata; numeric thresholds/minimum samples remain TEST_REQUIRED. Add hysteresis release/cooldown so a transient burst cannot pin the gear indefinitely.

disagreements.finding: Holding current_gear during high shift-rate can create prolonged under-gearing. Safety downshifts remain immediate, but there is no bounded latency/service-level test proving required safe upshifts or performance recovery are not delayed excessively.
disagreements.required_change: Add maximum hold/cooldown or confidence-decay policy plus paired performance non-regression tests. Anti-thrash must be safety-preserving and throughput-neutral/bounded, not merely shift-count reducing.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently only changes the reason string, not selected gear. This is safer than behavioral reinforcement, but the semantic phrase 'supports maintaining' could later become self-reinforcing if wired into routing without independent outcome anchoring.
disagreements.required_change: Keep it observational until independently derived from verified closures over a precommitted denominator/window. Any future behavioral use requires causal ablation and anti-self-reinforcement tests.

disagreements.finding: Experience credit weights 5/4/3 and operational credit 1 are engineering heuristics. Summed credit is not a calibrated capability, truth, trust or personality measure.
disagreements.required_change: Contract must explicitly forbid treating aggregate score as capability truth, trust, identity/personality evidence or promotion threshold without separate calibration/validation. All weights and thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Contract lists appropriate metrics but no paired-baseline protocol, matched workload, observation duration, uncertainty, precommit or non-inferiority rule is executable yet. Commit count, wake count or awake time therefore cannot support a speedup claim.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired baseline/candidate runs on matched workload using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with risk/verification quality non-regression and TEST_REQUIRED statistical criteria.

statistical_risks: recent_shift_rate_ratio has no denominator/sample-size/window semantics, creating small-n false positives.
verified_progress_density has no denominator/window/independence definition and may inherit selection bias from only recording successful verified events.
Credit weights 5/4/3 are ordinal heuristics, not interval-scale capability measurements; sums should not be compared as if linear ability gain.
Anti-thrash can mechanically improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency or verified closures, so shift-rate reduction alone is not success.
Speedup assessment without paired matched workloads is confounded by task mix, incident frequency, verifier availability, window age and route complexity.
Operational defect discovery can increase during worse system behavior; counting more ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is not necessarily positive capability growth.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE signal with forged secretary_signal_fresh=true must fail closed unless a trusted freshness envelope validates.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002: secretary signal conflicting with newer MISSION_STATE must be ignored even when caller supplies authority_conflict=false.
GB21-FRESHNESS-CLOCK-003: timestamp rollback/forward jump, expired TTL and replayed secretary envelope cannot regain freshness.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 shift observations cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent minimum-support policy; threshold/sample policy TEST_REQUIRED.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: transient burst followed by stable demand must permit bounded-time safe upshift; compare cycle latency and verified closure throughput.
GB21-SAFETY-UPSHIFT-006: an upshift required by a predeclared safe-service constraint must not be indefinitely suppressed by stale shift-rate history.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: forged verified_progress_density=1.0 cannot confer any routing/Experience/promotion authority.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: same canonical evidence replayed under 10,000 distinct event_ids credits exactly once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009: independently_verified='false', '0', object, list and non-bool values must fail closed, never produce verified credit.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-010: verified event without exact evidence hash + trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-CROSS-EVENT-EVIDENCE-011: two event_ids pointing to same evidence/verifier receipt count once; same event_id with different evidence is rejected as identity conflict.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-012: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND may change only operational_progress; verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority remain byte-identical.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-013: identical total credit assembled from different event mixes cannot be interpreted as equivalent capability; no promotion logic may key only on summed weight.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-014: matched baseline vs candidate workload reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit count/wake duration excluded.
GB21-V1-V2-NONREGRESSION-015: all verified v1 tests and current v2 tests remain unchanged PASS candidates before any v2.1 adoption claim.
release_condition: Do not claim Gearbox v2.1 C PASS from this review.
Fresh secretary influence must be derived from trusted, replay-resistant freshness evidence and exact authority snapshot comparison, not caller booleans.
Verified Experience must require exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt/identity; non-bool verification values fail closed.
Experience dedupe must resist same-event/new-ID replay using canonical evidence lineage identity.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and cannot promote verified Experience, P_base or authority.
Anti-thrash must have TEST_REQUIRED window/sample support and demonstrate bounded performance/recovery non-regression while preserving immediate safety downshift.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement/selection bias.
5/4/3 credit weights remain heuristic; total score cannot be used as capability truth or promotion threshold without separate calibration.

Any speedup claim requires paired matched baseline evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification quality/risk; commit count or awake time is forbidden evidence.
Formal adoption still requires exact-current executable regression evidence + adversarial review + Navigator synthesis + existing A->B->C.
next_lane: After latest-only review write/readback, return to Always-on Runtime / Small-World only when their exact endpoint/authority permits; no formal mutation from W02.
